outcome: Land HMS Daring: reformulate Luikov-tin with observed T_air(t) and h_eff(t) extracted from sensors (replacing fitted T_oven_eff and Bi_top); add oven-spring alpha(T) piecewise profile (alpha_post/alpha_pre as free parameter or pinned at 0.4); per-fixture diagnostics for steam phase and oven spring window; reduced free parameters from M15's 8 down to 4-5.
success_metric: Phase 1 diagnostic outputs per-fixture: steam-phase start/end, oven-spring detection window (50-65 deg C bulk dough), T_air(t) extraction, h_eff(t) extraction. Phase 2 inverse: 4-5 free params (L, D, Lu, q_bottom_eff, optionally alpha_ratio); main-bake RMSE comparison vs M15 (6.1 deg C); LOO deep-end T1 test vs M15 (11.7 deg C). If main-bake RMSE less than 4 deg C and parameters interior verdict GO; if 4-6 GO-WITH-CAVEATS; if greater than 6 deg C the information limit is final.
